content.short: Demex is a cross-chain order book DEX built on the Carbon network, supporting derivatives and spot trading.
content.description: Demex is a comprehensive decentralized exchange built on the Carbon blockchain, a specialized Cosmos-based network designed for high-performance financial applications. The platform features an advanced order book model that supports a wide range of products, including spot trading, futures, and perpetuals, across multiple blockchain ecosystems. Through its integration with the Carbon network and the SWTH utility token, Demex provides a highly scalable and interoperable trading environment that minimizes the friction of cross-chain asset management. By offering institutional-grade trading tools in a non-custodial framework, Demex empowers users with the freedom to trade any asset from any chain with professional-grade speed and security.
content.meta: Demex offers professional cross-chain order book trading for spot and derivatives. Discover Demex and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
